chunks: We had drowned the people of Noah when they had accused the apostles of lies, and turned them into an example for men. We have prepared a painful punishment for the wicked.
ai.seo_question: What happened to the people of Noah when they rejected the messengers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the causal link between the collective rejection of divine messengers and the subsequent divine punishment, serving as a historical precedent for the fate of disbelievers. The term 'ayah' (sign) underscores the didactic purpose of the flood, transforming a physical catastrophe into a spiritual lesson for all generations. This narrative reinforces the concept of 'Adl' (Divine Justice), where the punishment is a direct consequence of the people's persistent denial of truth.
